description: A pill-shaped label that pops in with a spring and then loops a soft pulsing glow ring around itself — for 'LIVE' tags, single-word accent callouts, or alerts against the Signal near-black background. The pulse is a continuous loop, independent of enter/exit timing.

accentColorToken.description: color of the pulsing glow ring; defaults to the resolved typography color

pulse.description: set false to render a static badge with no looping glow ring

pulsePeriodFrames.description: length in frames of one full pulse cycle
